-[#zzz]-> first
second;
=== repeat while bad color
repeat
:a;

repeat
:a;

=== backward bad outgoing color
repeat
:a;

:b;
endif

:a;

:b;

=== else bad color
if (c) then
:a;
else (-[#zzz]-> no)
:b;
endif

:a;
endif
=== if2 bad stereo color

:a;
endif
=== endif bad stereo color
if (c) then
:a;
endif <<#zzz>>
=== while bad stereo color

:a;
endwhile

=== switch bad stereo color

case (a)
